title: docs(flows): 'org:members reaches nobody' with no organization holds under the single posture only; under group the notify step fails
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (an out-of-diff observation of the at-tier contract review 6887230505 of PR #33577, card #32961; the in-diff twin is that record's should-fix on the skill line). `reach:` an author reading `flows.mdx` expects a notify step with no organization to succeed with no recipients; under the `group` posture the step fails instead.

**What is wrong.** `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (on `main`, around lines 346 to 349) says: "where there is none, `org:members` reaches nobody ... each with a warning in the server log." That holds under the `single` posture only. Under `group`, a `schedule` flow that declares no organization is a legal armed shape, and the messaging service's `emit()` writes the `sys_notification` event row before it resolves the audience. With no organization that write is refused with `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`, and the notify node's catch returns `success: false` (`notify-node.ts`, around lines 1385 to 1394), so the step fails rather than reaching nobody. Under `isolated` such a flow never binds.

**What lands.** Name the posture in the sentence: under `single` it reaches nobody with a server-log warning and the step succeeds; under `group` the step fails with `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`; the remedy is the schedule flow's declared acting organization. Re-read the three files above on `main` before writing. If the server lane ever passes the resolver the organization stamped on the event row instead of the producer's (`messaging-service.ts` around lines 1400 to 1420, intended per its comment), this sentence and the skill line in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` must move together.

Docs only, `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue "org:members" posture` and `is:issue flows.mdx org:members` → #32961 (the skill side) only. **New.**
